<a id="update_boat"></a>
### [`update_boat`](../../../../src/enemy/boat.asm#L6) `$6A1F`

*routine*

Starts and moves the boat (sprite 1) on the river. A bomb burst or a bullet sinks it. Timer $4053 sets the next start.
